## Movie_ExcitationTable

Original: `arm9/ov016:02191578`; `data_ov016_02191578`.

Movie audio excitation reconstruction levels, indexed by 6-bit scale and 3-bit symbol. At 021913f8 the decoder computes this table base; subsequent lsl#5 chooses an eight-int scale row, and 02191218 loads one symbol level. These signed excitation values feed the predictive filter at 0219145c.

Observed span: 2048 bytes to the next configured symbol, bounded by the module. This is not a proven object size; aliases can split larger objects and spans can include padding.

## InitializeModsStreamBuffers_MovieCoefficientVariableLengthDecoderLookup

Original: `arm9/ov016:02191d78`; `data_ov016_02191d78`.

Movie coefficient variable-length decoder lookup. A 12-bit lookahead indexes packed records: consumed bit count, magnitude, zero run and last-coefficient flag. Embedded decoder at 02199f14 extracts these four fields; escape paths at 02199e34/02199e88 add magnitude/run corrections from the trailing tables. Exact codec revision and original table names remain unknown.

## GetOrCopyFixedDecoderTable_MovieCoefficientVariableLengthDecoderLookup

Original: `arm9/ov016:02193e78`; `data_ov016_02193e78`.

Movie coefficient variable-length decoder lookup. A 12-bit lookahead indexes packed records: consumed bit count, magnitude, zero run and last-coefficient flag. Embedded decoder at 02199f14 extracts these four fields; escape paths at 02199e34/02199e88 add magnitude/run corrections from the trailing tables. Exact codec revision and original table names remain unknown.

Observed span: 8448 bytes to the next configured symbol, bounded by the module. This is not a proven object size; aliases can split larger objects and spans can include padding.
